profile.headline: Software Engineering
profile.summary:
• Extensive experience in  .Net Framework 1.1 to 4.5, C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, WPF, WCF, Entity Framework, Web Services, Windows Services , jQuery, IIS , LINQ and SQL Server.

• Good experience in .NET MVC 3.0/4.0 using Razor View Engine, Razor Layouts and Razor Helpers using CSHTML.
•	Proficient in designing applications using Design Patterns such as Creational, Structural and Behavioral including Singleton, Factory, Façade, Prototype and Dependency Injection etc.
•	Proficient in developing activities using technologies such as .Net Framework and Agile Methodology, Waterfall Model and SOA architecture.
•	Over 7 years of development also includes database related work primarily using MS-SQL Server with also other RDBMS servers like Oracle, MS Access.
•	Translated complicated enterprise specific business rules and procedures into appropriate business logic components such as code libraries, stored procedures and security models.
•	Experience in all phases of software design lifecycle management and implementation.
•	Excellent analytical, problem solving, communication, Knowledge transfer and interpersonal skills with ability to interact with individuals at all the levels.
•	Experience in working in different domain like Retail, Banking, Financing, Marketing and Healthcare.
•	Good knowledge of design documentation and documentation of different phases of SDLC
•	Intensive knowledge and experience in source control and version control (MS VSS, TFS)
•	In depth experience with program design, specification development, program logic, flow charting, testing debugging and documentation Web front end development projects
•	Ability to work in-groups as well as independently with minimal supervision
